title: Agent skills: from reusable know-how to verified work

source.title: Agent Skills primary-source evidence and teaching model

scope.name: Skill-enabled work and skill improvement
scope.boundary: Conceptual lifecycle across package, agent, host and tools. Codex-specific facts are explicitly scoped; maintenance gates are a proposed design.
scope.decision: Understand how to use and improve skills without confusing guidance with tool access

actors.label: Skill maintainer
actors.description: Curates focused methods and tests candidate revisions.

actors.label: Host runtime
actors.description: Discovers accessible packages and mediates access and execution.

actors.label: Execution tools
actors.description: Return operation results, artifacts or errors.

actors.label: Independent evaluator
actors.description: Judges actual outcomes against task expectations.

operationalActivities.label: Achieve a requested outcome
operationalActivities.description: Use suitable guidance on actual user inputs.

operationalActivities.label: Make guidance usable
operationalActivities.description: Provide discoverable and trusted packages within the host environment.

operationalActivities.label: Carry out a bounded operation
operationalActivities.description: Execute a requested permitted operation and return evidence.

operationalActivities.label: Improve reusable know-how
operationalActivities.description: Revise a method in response to new needs and observed failures.

operationalActivities.label: Compare actual outcomes
operationalActivities.description: Judge candidate outputs independently of the authoring context.

logicalComponents.label: Skill-enabled work system
logicalComponents.description: Teaching boundary connecting reusable guidance, task application and improvement.

logicalComponents.label: Agent interpretation
logicalComponents.description: Turns intent and guidance into task-specific decisions.

logicalComponents.label: Working context
logicalComponents.description: Contains the currently relevant instructions and evidence, not every installed file.

logicalComponents.label: Skill package
logicalComponents.description: Reusable authored content; not an autonomous worker.

logicalComponents.label: Execution coordination
logicalComponents.description: Requests operations and interprets their outcomes.

logicalComponents.label: Outcome assurance
logicalComponents.description: Checks source meaning and observable output.

logicalComponents.label: Skill evolution
logicalComponents.description: Compares candidate revisions and retains the released baseline.

contextExchanges.label: Intent, input files and explicit selection
contextExchanges.description: The task owner supplies the requested outcome, source files and any explicitly selected skill to the agent.
contextExchanges.item: Intent, input files and explicit selection
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

contextExchanges.label: Accessible trusted package locations
contextExchanges.description: The host exposes package locations that are available in its environment and allowed by its trust policy; a remote host may not have local user files.
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

contextExchanges.label: Capabilities and permission disposition
contextExchanges.description: Before an operation is requested, the host provides which tools are available and whether the intended action is allowed. A matching skill does not supply that authority.
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

contextExchanges.label: Operation request and inputs
contextExchanges.description: Execution coordination sends the selected tool an operation name and explicit inputs only after the applicable prerequisites and permissions are satisfied.
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

contextExchanges.label: Output artifact or error
contextExchanges.description: The tool returns an output artifact or an error. Execution coordination inspects that response before the agent can treat the task as complete.
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

contextExchanges.label: Reviewed result or precise blocker
contextExchanges.description: The agent returns the checked result to the task owner, or identifies the work that remains unresolved.
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

contextExchanges.label: Candidate revision and intended behavior
contextExchanges.description: The maintainer submits an identified candidate revision with the task scope and behavior it is intended to improve.
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

contextExchanges.label: Candidate and baseline outputs
contextExchanges.description: Outcome assurance supplies candidate and baseline outputs from comparable tasks for independent review.
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

contextExchanges.label: Comparative quality judgment
contextExchanges.description: The evaluator returns observed strengths, failures and regressions, without treating a favorable single example as universal reliability.
contextExchanges.condition: When the corresponding task, operation or revision requires this exchange

stateMachines.label: A skill revision is not automatically a release
stateMachines.description: Proposed lifecycle of an identified revision; prior released revision remains usable while the candidate is evaluated.
stateMachines.subject: LC_MAINTAIN
stateMachines.lifecycleExitCondition: An identified revision can be retired; future revisions have their own evidence.

decisions.label: Host integration remains specific
decisions.description: Check the receiving host for package locations, duplicate-name handling, trust filtering and implicit invocation settings before assuming a shared folder behaves identically there.
decisions.question: Which host and current configuration?

insights.label: A skill is one layer, not the whole agent
insights.description: Package guidance, contextual reasoning and execution have different roles.
insights.observation: The package supplies content while tools return effects and evidence.
insights.implication: Improve instructions for judgment failures; improve tooling for execution failures.

insights.label: Portable format does not guarantee portable execution
insights.description: Packages can be shared while runtime prerequisites differ.
insights.observation: Discovery, tool access and dependencies belong to the receiving host.
insights.implication: Check environment compatibility when reusing a skill.
